static_design_findings.qualification_deadlines: Bootstrap qualifiedUntil = DB at_time + interval '2 hours' (packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261024040000_diagnostic_intake_effects/migration.sql:98). Deadlines follow serial bootstrap order (helper:265-268), seconds apart. Reviewer-first bootstrap order per case gives reviewer < technician deadlines (F11, P06); clock set to the persisted deadline, as expireSelectedQualification does (helper:376-384).
static_design_findings.fixture_clock: DIAGNOSTIC_RUNTIME and IDENTITY_CLOCK read the private fixture now (helper:101,227-229). Reader authority uses runtime.now (PrismaDiagnosticDiscovery.ts:28,76; PrismaDiagnosticIdentityEvidence.ts:47-48). Session expiry stays 2027-01-01 (helper:258); no H1 case expires a Session.
static_design_findings.cursor: until=now, expires=now+15min (DiagnosticDiscoveryCursor.ts:14). F27/F33/F44 need +15min clock advance only.
static_design_findings.discovery_scan: orderBy id asc, take 21, page 20, fence createdAt <= cursor.until (PrismaDiagnosticDiscovery.ts:31-54). Report createdAt = runtime.now (PrismaDiagnosticReports.ts:44). Report ids are client-supplied UUIDs (contracts diagnostics.ts:105), so fixture-ordered ids reproduce the original id(4030+n) ordering for F39/F44/F46, and the later-arrival report gets an earlier-sorting id with a later clock.
static_design_findings.rights: Provenance/evidence rights are live while schedule.until > runtime.now (PrismaDiagnosticIdentityEvidence.ts:47-48,107-119,279-295). The evidence guard has no provenance/evidence rights cross-constraint (20261029190000:434-467). Per-visit provenance and evidence rights inputs isolate A provenance (F16), B evidence (F17), first-20 provenance (F46) and visit-50 provenance (F39).
static_design_findings.f20_semantic_note: Proof rightsUntil = min(A/B evidence rights, provenance rights) (PrivateContinuityAttestation.ts:133-135; PrismaDiagnosticContinuityProofs.ts:258-266). A proof-rights expiry is therefore always simultaneous with its earliest bound material expiry; there is no producer for an isolated proof-only expiry. Observable F20 outcome (empty handoffs, literal 403, zero reports/audits) is reachable; coordinator should confirm this coincidence is acceptable before implementation, or route F20 to disposition.
static_design_findings.audit_count_isolation: Original global diagnosticAudit.count oracles (F11/F16/F17/F20) assume per-test databases; e2e shares the worker DB, so the count needs per-case order scoping, to be recorded as isolation-equivalent in the map.
